answer.reason: Several verses tell of events on the mount: David's weeping ascent, Jesus' teaching about the end, and his going out after the hymn.

clauses.english: was climbed weeping by David and all his people
clauses.quote: David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up

clauses.english: was where Jesus sat and was asked about the sign of his coming
clauses.quote: as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately

clauses.english: was where Jesus went with his disciples after they sang the hymn
clauses.quote: they went out into the mount of Olives

doubts: 1KI 11:7 and 2KI 23:13 (Solomon's high places) speak of the hill before Jerusalem without naming the Mount of Olives, so they were left out.
ZEC 14:4 is a future prophecy and was not used as an event.
ACT 1:12 only says the disciples returned from Olivet, so it was not used.
